feeding_claim.verbatim: Our animals never receive any grain or corn

resold_note: The farm store also sells organic and pastured meats and other goods whose source farms the site does not name.
notes: Organic Brown Swiss and Jersey dairy on 170 acres on the northwest side of Indianapolis, with a creamery, farm store, dairy bar and farmstead restaurant. Read the homepage, farm, who we are, products, milk and farm store pages (WebFetch summaries only, so recheck the verbatim quote). Products page says '100% grassfed' and no grain ever; who we are says the cows are fed a 100% grass diet. Milk is vat-pasteurized and non-homogenized, sold in returnable glass bottles; not raw. Farm store hours: closed Monday, Tue to Thu 9am to 8pm, Fri and Sat 9am to 9pm, Sun 10am to 4pm. Farm store page lists butter and 'Organic & Pastured meats' but does not say they come from the farm's own animals, so butter and meat were left out; no meat species found on the site. Retail channel based on the products page naming Kroger as a vendor award; no store list or shipping found. Organic labels are left to the USDA matching script.
